title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-09-16) — the only second-Tuesday September meeting in 21 years, so the gate lifts into quad-witching
source: EST: DERIVED FROM TWO FEDERAL RESERVE PRIMARIES, both fetched raw and parsed by machine on 2026-09-06 by the initial research that owns this file, neither inherited from a sibling ledger. (1) federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf (HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes), 60 of its 61 content streams inflated in-session, whose policy footnote reads VERBATIM: "The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday." (2) federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,826 bytes), whose 2027 panel parses to "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*". 2027-09-14 is a Tuesday, so the Saturday ten days earlier is 2027-09-04; the meeting ends Wednesday 2027-09-15, so the window closes at the end of Thursday 2027-09-16 -- the source's own worked example, with no inference of ours. The same arithmetic reproduces all seven other 2027 windows this calendar already carries (01-16, 03-06, 04-17, 05-29, 07-17, 10-16, 11-27) to the day. A THIRD SUPPORT WAS ATTEMPTED AND HONESTLY WITHHELD: this session ran its own decode of the PDF's grid shading and reproduced the rect census (39 grey 0.851 fills on the 2026 page, 38 on the 2027 page), but its day-mapping returned only 5 of the 8 KNOWN 2026 windows when validated on that control page, and returned an incorrect 09-01 -> 09-09 for this window on the 2027 page. The decoder was therefore discarded, not quoted -- see the ledger's leg 2, which records the failure so the family stops treating the decode as trivially reproducible. Filed estimate because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date -- fomccalendars.htm states verbatim that "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- so the promotion trigger is the 2027-07-27/28 meeting ratifying September 14-15, not a better fetch. Researched 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-06), which supersedes and shadows the two sibling proposals that discovered this event: fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04.from-consumer-confidence-2027-09-28.json and fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04.from-fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31.json. Both were read first, per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md, and both agree with this derivation to the day; they stay where they are and become inert. THE STRUCTURAL FACT THIS EVENT EXISTS FOR, measured across all 21 September FOMC meetings 2007-2027 parsed from the Board's own fourteen historical calendar pages plus the current panel: SEPTEMBER 2027 IS THE ONLY SEPTEMBER FOMC IN THAT SPAN TO START ON THE SECOND TUESDAY OF THE MONTH. Seventeen of the nineteen Tuesday-start Septembers are third-Tuesday, two are fourth (2009, 2018), and two years are Wednesday starts (2012, 2015). That single week of earliness generates the whole corridor: the gate opens 2027-09-04 rather than a structural 2027-09-11; Labor Day 2027-09-06 falls inside it, so its first three calendar days hold zero trading sessions and it runs 8 sessions rather than the usual 9; the last legal Fed voice is Friday 2027-09-03, which is also the August employment report by BLS's own reference-week rule; and the first post-gate session is Friday 2027-09-17, September quad-witching. WHAT THE LEDGER MEASURED AND THEN REFUSED: this gate's geometry is the one where the family's accumulating overhang premium stops working. Across the 19 realized September gates, where the first post-gate session is quad-witching the gate's last session runs 0.616% mean absolute S&P move against a 0.510% post-gate session and 1.010x (median 0.872x) its own September baseline, winning only 2 of 6; where it is not, the same construction gives 1.299% vs 0.813%, 1.361x, and 10 of 13. The pooled September figures (decision 0.979%, overhang 1.096%, post-gate 0.695%) reproduce the fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 ledger's own row to three decimals from an independently built pipeline, which is what makes the split credible rather than a parsing accident. Two further framings were refused on measurement, not argued away: Labor Day inside the gate is routine (5 of the 21 September gates), and payrolls landing on the deadline session is routine AND quieter (9 of 19, running 0.791% against 0.887% when it lands elsewhere). IMPACT MEDIUM AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: symbols is empty, a gate has no issuer and prints no number, and no house playbook is calendar-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped this session for 'holiday|labor day|closure|half-day|early close|blackout': zero hits in both). Estimates only widen caution and nothing here licenses an entry. Full stance, kill switches and three registered forward tests: docs/research/events/fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04.md
